architecture.canvas: Canvas: ScreenSpaceOverlay, ScaleWithScreenSize1080x1920, matchWidth0, referencePPU100, existing GraphicRaycaster/EventSystem
architecture.safeArea: Existing SafeAreaFitter on MobileUIRoot and title pages; verified via iPhone12 Device Simulator
architecture.layers: Scene registry labels HUD/Workbench/Page/Overlay; Canvas-root aliases remain for existing factories and Back ordering. No second gameplay owner/router.
architecture.compatibility: Original Canvas/MobileUIRoot and modal-root aliases remain. Sword content and menu children use direct retained references after reparenting.
architecture.navigationOwner: MobileDrawerUIController + MobileUINavigationManager + MainMenuManager. MobileUIReconstruction only forwards OpenWorkbench/Back and resolves view anchors.
architecture.dataOwner: Existing services/controllers. New IMobileUIActionSource/ActionSnapshot/View contracts subscribe/unsubscribe their own callback and never compute costs or grants.

verification.contractMethod: Edit preview instances; OnEnable/OnDisable explicitly dispatched for lifecycle method contracts, not a physical-device test.

limitations: Editor simulation only; no APK/iOS build or physical-device touch/performance certification.
Not every inventory transaction, trial strategy/result or asynchronous reward state was executed. Those retain original owners and bindings.
Recovery, inactive legacy systems, PC module and third-party sample scenes are retained; no new diagnostics/gameplay features are fabricated.
